title: parakohleria parviflora
intro: Parakohleria parviflora, commonly known as the White Kohleria, is a plant species belonging to the Gentianaceae family. It is a flowering plant native to the Andes mountains in South America, known for its medicinal properties and ornamental value. The health benefits of Parakohleria parviflora include its potential to reduce inflammation and improve cardiovascular health, while its therapeutic actions include its antimicrobial, anti-inflammatory, and antioxidant properties. The bioactive constituents of Parakohleria parviflora include iridoid glycosides, which are responsible for its medicinal properties and are also found in other plants with similar health benefits.
